title: Totem Offhand Warning
description: Shows a subtle red vignette when you have a totem but forget to hold it in your offhand.
body:
## 🔴 Totem Offhand Warning

Never forget your totem again.

This mod displays a **subtle red vignette effect** on the edges of your screen when:
- You have at least one Totem of Undying in your inventory
- But you are NOT holding one in your offhand

---

## ✅ Features

- Clean **corner-based red vignette** (not full screen)
- Only shows when actually needed
- No effect if:
  - You already have a totem in offhand
  - You have no totems at all
- Lightweight and client-side only

---

## 🎯 Purpose

Designed for PvP and survival players who:
- Forget to offhand their totem
- Want a **non-intrusive visual reminder**
- Prefer minimal UI instead of loud warnings

---

## ⚙️ Technical

- Minecraft: **1.21.11**
- Loader: **Fabric**
- Mappings: Mojang
- Client-side only (safe for servers)

---

## 📌 Notes

This mod does NOT:
- Change gameplay
- Add items
- Require server installation

---

## 🔧 Commands

- /totemwarning off
- /totemwarning on

---
